title: Balanced brackets
hints: Pattern: stack. A closing bracket must match the most recently opened bracket, and a list with append/pop gives you exactly that.
Push each opener. On a closer, pop the top and compare it with the opener it should match (a dict from closer to opener helps).
Two failure cases: popping an empty stack (a closer with nothing open) and a mismatch of kind.
At the end the stack must be empty; `return not stack` covers the unclosed case.
